rows.descriptionText:
Reference Number: HRD-002793

Salary: SO2 £41,511 - £43,449

Advert closing date: 18/10/2026

Department: Housing, Regeneration, Development

Location: Edmonton Green Housing Hub

Contract type: Permanent

Division: Housing and Regeneration

Hours Per Week: 36

Contract End Date: Not specified

Interview Date: Not specified

Job Description

Asset Data Analyst

Do you enjoy turning complex data into meaningful insights? Do you take pride in improving data quality and spotting opportunities to make information work harder? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst within the Building Safety & Asset Data Team, this role sits within the Council Housing (Homes) Team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a forward-thinking team supporting the management of housing asset data during a period of ongoing digital transformation. You will play an important role in maintaining high-quality asset information, supporting investment planning, compliance activities and business decision-making across Council Housing.

We are looking for someone with strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail and a passion for data quality. You will be confident working with large datasets, identifying trends and producing accurate information to support operational and strategic objectives.

Within this role, we will expect you to:

Analyse, validate and maintain housing asset data to ensure accuracy, consistency and completenessProduce reports, dashboards and data insights to support compliance, investment planning and service improvementSupport the management and development of the Asset Management System and associated datasetsUndertake data cleansing, reconciliation and quality assurance activitiesWork collaboratively with internal teams and contractors to improve data collection and governance processesAssist in the development of new reporting tools, systems and ways of working to enhance data-driven decision making

Contact Details -

If you would like to know more about the role, please contact Ian Ranghel-Smerdon on Ian.Ranghel-Smerdon@enfield.gov.uk or Mark Provis on mark.provis@enfield.gov.uk for an informal discussion.

If you have any difficulties accessing this information, please contact Vickie McGrath on 0208 132 1053 or Vickie.McGrath@enfield.gov.uk

We do not see your name or title when shortlisting your application. This is one of many initiatives to build a more talented and diverse workforce. However, if you put your name on your CV or Statement it will be visible to us. For this reason, we ask that you do not include your name on these documents. Please note it is your responses to the Essential/Desirable criteria, as detailed in the Job Description and Person Specification which is available on the job advert, that will determine if you are shortlisted for an interview, therefore we encourage you to always address the essential and desirable criteria in your application/CV.

We are passionate about our people and how we deliver services to our community in Enfield. That’s why we encourage a culture that puts our customers at the heart of everything we do - by empowering our people to work together to find solutions, be open, honest and respectful, take responsibility and listen and learn. If you value these behaviours too, we’d love to hear from you - and of course we are always happy to talk flexible working, click  here to find out more.

Why it's great to work for Enfield Council:

An excellent pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). Up to 32 days annual leave depending on grade and length of service. You will also get eight public holidays per year and an extra day off at Christmas. A blend of remote and office based working for most roles. Interest free season ticket loan repayable over three or ten months. Career development and learning experiences from a range of training courses and learning methods. Employee Assistance Programme to provide advice and counselling services. This is a free and confidential service available to staff and members of their family. Health and leisure discounts and tax-free bikes for work. 1 month's paid sabbatical for registered Social Workers working in Children's Social Care. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy once a sufficient number of applications have been received. Therefore, we advise that you complete fully and submit your application as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

If you have previously applied for this role within the past 6 months, unfortunately, a second application will not be considered.

Certain posts in the Council are ‘politically restricted’ which means that staff employed in these posts may not undertake political activities either in or outside the workplace and therefore if candidates are affiliated with any political party, we may not be able to proceed with their application.

rows.title: Data & Project Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us
Lanas is igniting healthcare innovation. For nearly three decades, we have connected GPs, pharmacists, specialists, surgeons, and other healthcare professionals with the best technology possible, from trusted everyday systems to new innovative tools that add real value for our customers.
Our technology is used by millions of clinical users in over twenty countries. From core clinical workflows to AI-driven innovation, our products help reduce admin, improve access, drive efficiencies, and support safer, more connected care.
We are looking for a Data & Project Analyst to play a key role in the operational delivery and ongoing development of Maxwell Stanley's healthcare analytics solution and services. This is a hands-on role combining data analysis, client delivery and project coordination.
You will manage data preparation and processing, analyse outputs, prepare client deliverables and help ensure projects and managed services are delivered accurately and on time. You will also help improve the solution and its underlying processes, while providing project management support to our work with NHS Wales, including customer service desk queries, Privacy Solution activity and wider delivery support.
What you'll be doing• Manage the end-to-end receipt, preparation, cleansing and quality checking of large client data files.• Use Python-based scripts to support data validation and processing activities.• Upload and manage data within the analytics solution, export outputs and prepare them for client review.• Carry out advanced Excel analysis, including lookups, data matching, validation, reconciliation and trend identification.• Analyse audit findings and produce clear trend and insight reports, including professional PowerPoint presentations summarising outcomes, key findings and recommendations.• Ensure client deliverables meet agreed quality standards and timescales.• Review existing operational processes and workflows and identify opportunities to automate, streamline and improve them.• Support the review and enhancement of Python scripts used in solution delivery, or recommend alternative approaches where appropriate.• Analyse audit outputs and customer data to identify recurring trends, risks and opportunities, and contribute to new audit rules and solution enhancements.• Support the successful delivery of client projects and managed services, monitoring milestones, deliverables and timelines and escalating issues where appropriate.• Support customer enquiries received through the Maxwell Stanley helpdesk and assist in monitoring NHS Wales Privacy Solution activity and audit logging processes.• Build effective working relationships with clients, colleagues and other stakeholders.• Provide analytical and project support across the wider Lanas Group where required, contributing to other priority initiatives as the business evolves.
What we're looking for• Previous experience in a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Project Analyst or similar role.• Experience manipulating, validating and analysing large datasets.• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, PivotTables, formulas, data validation and data matching.• Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with excellent attention to detail.• Experience producing management reports, client deliverables and professional presentations.• Strong planning and organisational skills, with experience managing competing priorities and taking ownership of delivery.• Clear written and verbal communication and confidence working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
It would be an advantage if you also have:• Experience working in healthcare, the NHS or another public-sector environment.• Experience of healthcare information, audit, governance or privacy processes.• Python programming or scripting knowledge.• SQL and/or Power BI experience.• Previous experience working with healthcare analytics.
What you can expectThis is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data, healthcare and client delivery, with genuine ownership of analysis, project delivery and solution improvement. You will gain exposure to a range of stakeholders and projects, including work supporting NHS Wales and analytical priorities across the wider Lanas Group.• Company matched pension scheme.• 25 days annual leave• Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits.• Flexible working and work-from-home opportunities.• Two paid CSR Volunteering/Charity Days per year and one Wellbeing Day per year.• Full access to our Employee Assistance Programme, plus regular wellbeing support and webinars.• Annual leave purchase scheme.• Working abroad opportunities - 20 working days per year.Hybrid working, with regular attendance at the agreed office location to support collaboration and client delivery.
Lanas is an equal opportunities employer.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Data Analyst / Developer (SQL), Python, AI
Our client is a leading Investment Management company who committed to helping build a more sustainable future. Their Climate Solutions team develops and implements climate response strategies for clients while supporting the integration of climate considerations across their investment capabilities. Working closely with colleagues across Investments, ESG, Stewardship and Distribution, the team plays a key role in developing innovative climate analytics, identifying energy transition opportunities, and supporting climate-focused investment strategies.
The team are looking for a Data Analyst / Database Developer to help enhance their proprietary climate modelling toolkit and deliver scalable data solutions that enable better decision-making across the investment business. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical expertise with meaningful work that supports the transition to a low-carbon economy.
The role would suite someone who has good SQL skills (including Stored Procedures) together with some other coding experience (Python, R, AI). The role does not require Investment Management or ESG / Climate related experience but this is a great opportunity for someone who is interested in getting into this field / environment.
Key Responsibilities:Supporting the development and enhancement of climate scenarios, climate risk analytics, temperature alignment measures and related metrics within their existing platform.Collaborating with investment, ESG and climate specialists to deliver reporting and analytical solutions.Developing, optimising and maintaining SQL databases, stored procedures, functions and data pipelines.Building automated processes to ingest and manage large datasets from internal and external sources.Creating reporting and visualisation tools that support portfolio analysis and investment decision-making.Analysing climate and portfolio data to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights.Embedding AI-enabled solutions into existing workflows and exploring opportunities for future innovation.
Experience Required:Degree qualified in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Data Science or a related discipline.Strong SQL development skills, including experience creating efficient stored procedures, functions and views.Knowledge of database design principles and performance optimisation techniques.Experience working with Python and a willingness to further develop technical skills across modern technologies.Understanding of concepts such as window functions, CTEs, indexing, transactions, source control and job scheduling.Experience using GitHub or similar version control tools, including code review and collaboration practices.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with complex datasets.Interest in climate change, sustainable investing or climate modelling, alongside the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences.

rows.title: Public Health Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Data Analyst – Public Health

£44,982 - £54,507 

Fixed term – 12 months

Full time

Richmond and Wandsworth, with a minimum of 60% office-based working 

Required to be in the office 3 times a week

Are you motivated by the idea of using data to make a visible difference to people’s health and wellbeing? This is an exciting opportunity to use your analytical skills in a role where your insight will help Richmond and Wandsworth understand local need, strengthen decision-making and focus action where it can have the greatest impact for residents.

We are pleased to offer a 12-month fixed term opportunity for a Public Health Data Analyst to join the Assurance and Innovation Division within the Adult Social Care and Public Health Directorate. You will be part of a supportive and committed performance and intelligence function, working closely with Public Health colleagues, operational teams, commissioners and wider partners to turn complex data into clear, practical insight that shapes strategy, service planning and improvement.

About The Role

In this role, you will help strengthen Public Health intelligence across Richmond and Wandsworth by bringing together data, evidence and professional curiosity to answer important questions about population health, service need and health inequalities.

You Will

Analyse large and complex datasets, apply statistical and epidemiological methods, and produce high-quality outputs that support statutory duties and local priorities, including the Joint Strategic Needs Assessment, Annual Director of Public Health Report, Pharmaceutical Needs Assessment, health needs assessments, dashboards, and service evaluations.Help colleagues see the story behind the data. You will translate technical analysis into accessible reports, dashboards and visual insights that support evidence-based decisions, improve understanding of health and wellbeing outcomes, and help identify where services, programmes and partnerships can make the biggest difference.Have the opportunity to develop your expertise in a collaborative environment, working alongside Public Health specialists, the Adults Performance Team, Corporate Insight colleagues and external knowledge networks, including the London Knowledge and Intelligence Service. We will support you to share best practice, apply new approaches and continue building your skills in public health intelligence and data visualisation. Be comfortable working in a busy and changing environment, balancing competing priorities and collaborating with colleagues across different professional backgrounds. You will bring a strong eye for detail, sound judgement and a commitment to using data responsibly, securely and ethically. To undertake data and literature reviews (and other relevant searches), critically appraise the evidence, and produce clear evidence-based summaries and actionable recommendations to support the development, implementation and evaluation of policies, programmes and strategies that improve health and wellbeing and reduce health inequalities. 

In return, you will have the chance to contribute to meaningful work that supports better health, wellbeing and equity across two diverse London boroughs.

About You

We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical and motivated by the opportunity to use evidence to improve outcomes for local communities. You will already have experience in public health, health intelligence, social care, research, analytics or another relevant data-focused environment. What matters most is that you can work confidently with complex information, draw out meaningful insight and communicate it clearly to people who may not have a technical background.

Essential Qualifications, Skills And Experience

Experience analysing complex public health, health-related or similarly sensitive datasets and producing clear, actionable insight.Strong quantitative analytical skills, with an understanding of statistical, epidemiological or other relevant analytical methods.Experience contributing to health needs assessments, evaluations, intelligence reports, dashboards or similar analytical outputs.Highly developed IT and analytical skills, including tools such as Excel, Power BI, Power Query, SQL, R or Python.Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and evidence into clear narratives for a range of audiences.Experience managing confidential datasets securely and appropriately, in line with information governance, data protection and data sharing requirements.Good organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage a varied workload and work collaboratively across teams.A degree in public health, economics, biomedical science, statistics, data science, another numerate or health-related subject, or equivalent experience.

Closing Date: Sunday 1 November 2026

Shortlisting Date: w/c Monday 2 November 2026

Interview Date: Friday 20 November 2026

Test/Presentation: There will be a technical analytical assessment as part of the selection process. Further details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

For an informal conversation about the role, please contact Carl Fenty, Performance Manager Adults, at carl.fenty@richmondandwandsworth.gov.uk or Nike Arowobusoye, Consultant in Public Health, at Nike.Arowobusoye@richmondandwandsworth.gov.uk

Secondment

All internal applicants for this secondment must seek permission from their current line manager before applying. Failure to do so may result in the secondment not being authorised.

Richmond & Wandsworth Better Service Partnership are committed to making our recruitment practices as inclusive as possible for everyone. We are committed to promoting equality and diversity and developing a culture that values differences, recognising that employees from a variety of backgrounds bring important and positive contributions to the Councils and can improve the way we deliver services.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment and selection process, please let us know.

We are also committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people/vulnerable adults and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Some posts may be exempted under the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and as such appointment to these posts will be conditional upon the receipt of a satisfactory response to a check of police records via Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS).

We offer a wide range of benefits designed to attract, develop, and reward our employees such as 40 days annual leave (including Bank Holidays), flexible working and a generous pension plan.

rows.title: Paid Founder-in-Residence: Build an Industrial AI Startup (Energy)
rows.descriptionText:
About the opportunityThe Flywheel Venture Studio (www.theflywheel.studio) is recruiting exceptional operators, engineers, and domain experts to build category-defining companies that solve hard problems in Europe’s most critical sectors: Manufacturing, Defence and Energy.
We are looking for ambitious entrepreneurs with first-hand insights into industrial challenges, bottlenecks, and revenue blockers. We turn your insight into a formidable company. You keep up to 80% equity of the company we build together. 
We compress the 0 to 1 journey from years down to months. Accelerators, VCs, and incubators fund you and advise you. We build with you: validating the idea, shipping the first prototype, forming the founding team, incorporating, and winning your first customers and investors. 
As a Founder-in-Residence (FiR), you will be paid while validating, designing, and launching a new venture with hands-on support from experienced founders, operators, engineers, and industry partners. Successful residents receive up to €300k in committed capital at incorporation, and keep up to 80% of their equity. 
The studio’s 20+ investors, including former operators from Google, Boeing and NASA stand ready to make warm introductions to first buyers, pilots, and investors.Our Founder-in-Residence program is based in Thessaloniki, Greece.The hybrid residency gives you a focused environment for making decisions and moving quickly, while giving you access to Greece's strong English-speaking STEM talent pool and an efficient base for building your first product and team.
Successful ventures are free to build anywhere in Europe. 
The RoleAs a Founder-in-Residence, you will work closely with The Flywheel team to identify, validate, and build a venture that uses AI to accelerate productivity and efficiency in one of our core domains:Manufacturing & Supply ChainsDefence & SecurityEnergy & Sustainability
You will operate as the future CEO or CTO of a company formed during or after the program. This is a highly entrepreneurial role for individuals ready to build a 0–1 company with structured guidance, material support and capital.
ResponsibilitiesDuring the FiR Program (ideally 1-3 months, up to 6 months):Conduct deep user research and problem validation across target industriesGenerate or evaluate multiple venture concepts and select a high-potential directionDevelop early prototypes (with The Flywheel engineering support)Validate customer demand, willingness to pay, and pathway to profitabilityRun experiments, pilots, and market testsBuild early business models, market segmentation & analysis, and GTM strategyDevelop and present the investment case for NewCo creationUpon NewCo Formation:Become CEO or CTO of the new companyUse The Flywheel’s €300k investment to launch the ventureBuild the core founding team with our recruiting supportSecure early customers/pilots with Flywheel’s industry partners Lead further capital raises with support from The Flywheel. Drive execution toward product-market fit and long-term growth
RequirementsWe are looking for high-agency, deeply competent builders. Successful candidates should have one or more of the following:Several years of experience in one or more of our focus areasStrong product/technical leadership experience building from 0–1A track record of solving complex problems and delivering outcomesStrong communication and leadership abilityA willingness to own the company end-to-end as CEO, or lead the technical direction of the company as CTONice-to-haves:Prior entrepreneurial experience (startup founder, early employee, product owner, technical lead)B2B enterprise sales or business development backgroundExperience managing engineering or product teamsExperience raising capital Network of industry buyers
You do not need a fully formed idea or prototype to apply.
Who should not applyYou already have traction, pilots, or a funded company and mainly need capital. We build companies; we don't just fund them.You can't point to a specific problem you've seen first-hand, or to the buyer who pays to solve it. You don't need a polished idea. You do need real insight.Your problem sits outside Manufacturing & Supply Chains, Defence & Security, and Energy & Sustainability.
What We Offer(€4k/month) to validate idea, up to €300k at incorporation, you keep up to 80% of NewCoA real co-founder: We work beside you from first idea to first customers. You keep up to 80% of the company we build together. Instant credibility and access: backed by 20+ investors, including former operators from Google, Boeing, NASA, and the European Commission. A team that builds with you: fractional engineering, design, and go-to-market operators.User research & validation frameworksAI architecture & technical prototypingBusiness modeling & pricing strategyAccess to industrial pilot programs and buyers Team formation and recruitment of technical talentCompany formation, legal, and IP supportPre-incorporation: €4,000/month stipend to properly validate the idea for up to six months. Post-incorporation: Up to €300k in initial fundingA path to your Series A: guidance and warm intros to US and EU investors, from founders with multiple raises and exits. 

How our application process works We review applications on a rolling basis. The process: a 7-minute application, a 30-minute screening call, then a deep-dive session before an offer. Most applicants hear back within 5 days.

As a Founder-in-Residence (FiR), you will be paid while validating, designing, and launching a new venture with hands-on support from experienced founders, operators, engineers, and industry partners. Successful residents receive up to €300k in committed capital at incorporation, and keep up to 80% of their equity. 
The studio’s 20+ investors, including former operators from Google, Boeing and NASA stand ready to make warm introductions to first buyers, pilots, and investors.
Our Founder-in-Residence program is based in Thessaloniki, Greece.The hybrid residency gives you a focused environment for making decisions and moving quickly, while giving you access to Greece's strong English-speaking STEM talent pool and an efficient base for building your first product and team.
Successful ventures are free to build anywhere in Europe. 
The RoleAs a Founder-in-Residence, you will work closely with The Flywheel team to identify, validate, and build a venture that uses AI to accelerate productivity and efficiency in one of our core domains:Manufacturing & Supply ChainsDefence & SecurityEnergy & Sustainability
You will operate as the future CEO or CTO of a company formed during or after the program. This is a highly entrepreneurial role for individuals ready to build a 0–1 company with structured guidance, material support and capital.
ResponsibilitiesDuring the FiR Program (ideally 1-3 months, up to 6 months):Conduct deep user research and problem validation across target industriesGenerate or evaluate multiple venture concepts and select a high-potential directionDevelop early prototypes (with The Flywheel engineering support)Validate customer demand, willingness to pay, and pathway to profitabilityRun experiments, pilots, and market testsBuild early business models, market segmentation & analysis, and GTM strategyDevelop and present the investment case for NewCo creationUpon NewCo Formation:Become CEO or CTO of the new companyUse The Flywheel’s €300k investment to launch the ventureBuild the core founding team with our recruiting supportSecure early customers/pilots with Flywheel’s industry partners Lead further capital raises with support from The Flywheel. Drive execution toward product-market fit and long-term growth
RequirementsWe are looking for high-agency, deeply competent builders. Successful candidates should have one or more of the following:Several years of experience in one or more of our focus areasStrong product/technical leadership experience building from 0–1A track record of solving complex problems and delivering outcomesStrong communication and leadership abilityA willingness to own the company end-to-end as CEO, or lead the technical direction of the company as CTONice-to-haves:Prior entrepreneurial experience (startup founder, early employee, product owner, technical lead)B2B enterprise sales or business development backgroundExperience managing engineering or product teamsExperience raising capital Network of industry buyers
You do not need a fully formed idea or prototype to apply.
Who should not applyYou already have traction, pilots, or a funded company and mainly need capital. We build companies; we don't just fund them.You can't point to a specific problem you've seen first-hand, or to the buyer who pays to solve it. You don't need a polished idea. You do need real insight.Your problem sits outside Manufacturing & Supply Chains, Defence & Security, and Energy & Sustainability.
What We Offer(€4k/month) to validate idea, up to €300k at incorporation, you keep up to 80% of NewCoA real co-founder: We work beside you from first idea to first customers. You keep up to 80% of the company we build together. Instant credibility and access: backed by 20+ investors, including former operators from Google, Boeing, NASA, and the European Commission. A team that builds with you: fractional engineering, design, and go-to-market operators.User research & validation frameworksAI architecture & technical prototypingBusiness modeling & pricing strategyAccess to industrial pilot programs and buyers Team formation and recruitment of technical talentCompany formation, legal, and IP supportPre-incorporation: €4,000/month stipend to properly validate the idea for up to six months. Post-incorporation: Up to €300k in initial fundingA path to your Series A: guidance and warm intros to US and EU investors, from founders with multiple raises and exits. 

How our application process works We review applications on a rolling basis. The process: a 7-minute application, a 30-minute screening call, then a deep-dive session before an offer. Most applicants hear back within 5 days.

rows.title: CRO Executive
rows.descriptionText:
CRO ExecutiveSalary: £40,000–£50,000London | Hybrid
Our client is a rapidly growing international media subscription business with an established presence across the UK, US and Australia. With ambitious plans for continued expansion, you’ll join a business where experimentation and customer behaviour directly shape commercial performance. 
This is an excellent opportunity to build your CRO career while working across a high-traffic digital proposition, gaining exposure to experimentation, analytics, UX, product and subscription growth. You’ll work closely with an experienced Senior CRO Manager and collaborate with a broad range of teams, giving you the opportunity to see your ideas move from hypothesis through to measurable results.
The CRO Executive will play a hands-on role in improving digital conversion and the customer journey, using evidence, experimentation and analysis to identify opportunities and increase subscription performance across multiple markets.
Role HighlightsDevelop data-led hypotheses and turn customer behaviour into testing opportunities.Plan, launch and evaluate A/B tests across web and app experiences.Coordinate testing activity, campaigns, timelines and results across the CRO roadmap.Analyse experiments and present clear, commercially focused recommendations to stakeholders.Support paywall, landing page, personalisation and audience segmentation initiatives.
You Will NeedPractical CRO and digital analytics knowledge, with around one year’s experimentation experience.Experience with VWO, Optimizely, Adobe Target, AB Tasty or a comparable testing platform.Strong analytical ability and confidence translating results into straightforward recommendations.Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and event tracking within digital experiments.A curious, organised and proactive approach, with an interest in UX and digital customer journeys.
Why You’ll Love ItWork on a high-traffic international subscription proposition spanning three major markets.Gain broad exposure across CRO, Product, Analytics, UX, CRM, Editorial and Acquisitions.Develop your expertise alongside an experienced Senior CRO Manager.25 days’ holiday, increasing annually to a maximum of 30 days.Pension, life cover, shopping and dining discounts, onsite gym and subsidised canteen.
You’ll also have access to an Employee Assistance Programme, onsite nurse and GP clinics, plus additional benefits as your time with the business develops.
Apply today to take your CRO career further with an ambitious international business committed to equality of opportunity for all employees and job applicants. Approximately 60% Networking / 40% End-User Computing & IT Infrastructure Support.Seeking to secure a hands-on IT Network Engineer to take responsibility for the configuration, administration, maintenance & troubleshooting of Network & core IT Infrastructure across 4 School Sites - all within approximately 5–10 minutes' walking distance.
The role will focus predominantly on networking (60%), including Switching, Wireless Connectivity, Firewalls & Network Security, alongside providing 2nd & 3rd Line IT Support across Microsoft 365, Intune, Endpoint Management, Windows Server & End User Computing Infrastructure (40%).
Technical Skills Required:2nd & 3rd Line IT Support: Troubleshooting complex Networking, Infrastructure, hardware & software issues through to root-cause resolution.Network Infrastructure: Hands-on configuration, administration & troubleshooting of network switches, routers, wireless access points & controllers, including Cisco & Netgear networking technologies.Networking: Strong knowledge of VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, TCP/IP, IP addressing, Subnetting, DNS & DHCP.Wireless Networking: Configuration & troubleshooting of Wireless Networks, including access points, coverage, channel planning & authentication.Network Security: Smoothwall firewalls, firewall rules, NAT, VPNs, web/content filtering, network segmentation and security policies.Microsoft 365: Strong administration experience across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, SharePoint & MS Teams.Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Management: Hands-on experience with Intune, device enrolment, Autopilot, configuration profiles, application deployment & compliance policies.Windows Server: Active Directory, Group Policy, file & print services, virtualisation, backup & recovery.Multi-Site Infrastructure: Supporting Network connectivity and IT Infrastructure across 4 locations, including liaison with ISPs and external suppliers.Audio/Visual Equipment: Smart Boards, projectors, interactive displays & classroom technology.Additional IT Support: VoIP telephony, printers, CCTV, access control and school IT systems.Excellent communication skills, strong problem-solving ability and a proactive approach.
Desirable Experience:Previous IT / Network Engineering experience within the Education Sector, ideally supporting schools.macOS, Apple devices, iPads & Apple Device Management - Jamf & Apple School Manager.Networking certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+ or Security+.Experience with School Management Systems such as iSAMS, SIMS or Arbor.Experience with virtualisation technologies including VMware or Hyper-V.
Working Hours:Full-Time Onsite - Monday to Friday, 8.00am - 4.30pm (TBC) - Term Periods.Some flexibility may be required for Network upgrades & Infrastructure projects outside normal school hours or during school holidays.
Benefits Package:27 days annual leave + Bank Holidays / Salary Sacrifice Pension / Free Lunches During Term Time / Training & Professional Development / Support Towards Technical Certifications / Cycle to Work Scheme.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

rows.title: Reinsurance Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Location: London

Contract Type: Permanent

Work Pattern: Full Time and Hybrid

If you love and understand financial risk – Assessing it. Evaluating it. Managing it. Advising on it. – You’ll fit right in.

The Reinsurance Pricing Analyst role will be part of a team of seven (and wider Pricing team of twenty-six), providing coverage for Reinsurance businesses across Property, Casualty and Specialty lines. The successful candidate will report to the Reinsurance Pricing Actuary and will also be responsible for supporting on other cross-class Pricing deliverables where required.

About The Job

What you’ll spend your time doing:

As a Reinsurance Pricing Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of supporting Underwriting with data-driven insights. While no two days are alike, here’s a snapshot of some key responsibilities:

Collaborate with underwriters to assess risk and optimise pricing strategies in line with syndicate profitability targets.Produce clear, data-driven pricing recommendations and present findings to senior stakeholders by carrying out large account case pricing.Support the change and continuous improvements across the pricing team, ensuring that processes, models, and strategies evolve to meet business needs and industry best practices.Support the Pricing team on other cross-class activities such as running the quarterly Pricing KPIs and annual inflation reviewsAnalyse and interpret both external and internal data to create robust pricing models that support business objectives and improve underwriting profitability.Work with Pricing management and other actuarial colleagues to provide critical insights in Pricing Portfolio Reviews, offering independent opinions on the quality of risks written to optimise portfolio profitability.Develop and maintain strong working relationships with the other members of the Pricing team, Underwriters, and all departments reporting to the Chief Actuary.Support Pricing management with the accuracy, development, and utilisation of management information for analysis and reporting purposes.Work cross-functionally with teams such as Exposure Management, Portfolio Management, and IT in Pricing Model Development when required.Contribute to automation initiatives that streamline pricing workflows and enhance analytical efficiency across the team.Continue to work towards full actuarial qualification.

You’re going to enjoy this job if you also…

Have an entrepreneurial mindset and like operating in a results-focused business.Are a strong problem solver, using statistical methods to tackle ‘real-world’ questionsCan explain complex data in simple terms Enjoy collaborating with underwriters, actuaries, and model developers to drive results.Have a drive for implementing change and improvements to models and processes.

What you’ll need:

For this particular role there are some important qualifications and experience we need you to have. These include:

Core skills:

Being an undergraduate in maths, economics or actuarial science, or other numerate discipline.Working towards an actuarial qualification.Experience in Pricing, Reinsurance or Insurance classes.Advanced knowledge of Excel.Proven ability to work with complex data, statistical analysis, and actuarial modellingStrong communication skills, both written and verbal.Excellent time management skills and an ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.Proficiency in SQL and VBA programming languages.

Advantageous skills:

Previous pricing experience in the London market.A talent to think laterally in order to develop solutions to support the continued improvement of services by the Technical Pricing team. Experience interpreting CAT modelling outputsAbility to take ownership of a project and deliver outcomes aligned with the team plan

We are stronger together because of our common interests and rich differences. You may be the strength we didn’t know we needed. Believe in yourself, and click apply today!

What Can You Expect From Us?

As well as a competitive base salary and performance related discretionary bonus, here is a link to our employee benefits - Benefits of working at MS Amlin | MS Amlin

Hybrid Working

At MS Amlin we operate a hybrid working model to empower our people with flexibility to blend where they work. We value collaboration and believe that we work better together, our teams typically do 3 days a week in the office.

About MS Amlin

MS Amlin is a leading (re)insurer and part of the global MS&AD Group, with operations across Lloyd’s of London, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. With over 120 years of experience, we support businesses facing complex and demanding risks, providing continuity in an uncertain world. Our expertise covers Property, Casualty, Marine, Crisis Management, Natural Resources and Reinsurance, backed by strong underwriting capabilities and deep sector knowledge. At the core of our claims service is TRUST - Transparency, Responsiveness, Understanding, Solution-driven thinking, and Technical expertise. This defines how we manage claims and build lasting relationships.

rows.title: Associate Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Department: Data & AILocation: UK - London

Description

Insurance isn’t the first industry most data scientists think of when they imagine cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) work, but the incredibly rich data and nature of the business make it a great place to put AI to use.

CFC's Data & AI team is building production agentic systems that automate complex underwriting decisions — not demos, not proofs of concept sitting on a shelf, but Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and machine learning (ML) pipelines that drive real business outcomes. This role will sit alongside senior data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers, as an analytical counterpart: running experiments, stress-testing assumptions, and generating the evidence that shapes what gets built and how to improve it over time.

This is an Associate Data Scientist role designed for someone early in their career who wants genuine exposure to production AI systems from day one. You'll work closely with, and have the opportunity to learn from, team members while contributing analysis and experimentation work that feeds into live services — such as statistical analysis and LLM evaluation. This will require the kind of careful, evidence-based thinking that makes the difference between an AI system that works in a notebook and one that holds up under real conditions.

The problems are genuinely hard. The data is complex, the decisions are high-stakes, and the domain has the kind of depth that keeps the work interesting. If you want to grow quickly in applied AI and ML — working on real systems, not toy datasets — this is the right environment.

About the role

Design and run experiments that directly shape production AI agents — testing ideas, validating approaches, and turning research into deployed improvements.Actively explore cutting-edge developments in AI and machine learning — with the space and support to experiment, prototype, and bring new techniques into production where they add value.Evaluate and refine LLM-powered workflows — building robust evaluation frameworks, stress-testing agent behaviour, and driving continuous quality improvements in live systems.Explore complex, real-world datasets to uncover insights that meaningfully improve underwriting decisions and system performance at scale.Prototype and iterate on features for AI/ML pipelines, taking ideas from early exploration through to measurable impact in production services.Investigate how agentic systems behave in production — identifying opportunities for improvement, failure modes, and ways to make systems more robust and reliable.Collaborate closely with ML/AI engineers to bridge research and production — contributing code, debugging issues, and shipping improvements end-to-end.Document and present experiments, findings, and methodologies clearly to both technical and business users, making sure insights are reproducible and decisions are traceable.

About you

You will have experience/be familiar with the following:

AI and LLMsFamiliarity with LLM-powered apps and services, evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and other generative AI work — whether through professional experience, coursework, or personal projects.Curiosity about how LLM-based systems behave in production and how to evaluate them rigorously.Experience with ML models (including deep models) and their lifecycle, including training, evaluation and inference.Exposure to experiment tracking tools (e.g. MLflow).Technical skillsProficiency in Python.Working knowledge of SQL for querying and preparing data.Comfort with Git and version control as part of a collaborative workflow.Basic grounding in CI/CD concepts and an interest in how software is tested and deployed.
Analytical foundationsSolid grounding in statistics and probability — comfortable with hypothesis testing, distributions, and drawing defensible conclusions from data.Hands-on experience with exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and building and evaluating ML models.Working knowledge of the core ML model lifecycle: data preparation, training, validation, and monitoring.Working styleDetail-oriented and methodical — you care about getting the analysis right, not just getting it done.Clear communicator, able to summarise findings and explain analytical decisions to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.Comfortable asking questions and working under the guidance of senior engineers while progressively taking on more ownership.Intellectually curious — the kind of person who pulls on threads and wants to understand why, not just what.Nice to haveExposure to designing, implementing, and managing business-critical applications in a production environment.Working knowledge of how ML/LLM systems get productionized: CI/CD pipelines, release processes, monitoring/observability.Knowledge of the insurance domain (not expected — the domain complexity is part of what makes this interesting).

Core Values

Love what you do:
We show up each day ready to take on the world. Our passion and intensity set us apart and makes the difference to our colleagues, customers, brokers and carriers.

Challenge everything:
We’re never afraid to question the way that things are done and we constantly challenge ourselves and others to makes things better.

Have fun, be good:
Insurance is a serious business, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We make it fun to work at CFC, we welcome all viewpoints, and we treat everyone how we would expect to be treated.

rows.title: Associate Image Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Advanced analytics. Intelligent insights.
IXICO plc (AIM: IXI), is a global leader in neuroscience imaging and biomarker analytics, using its proprietary AI-driven platform to help advance the treatment of neurological disorders and reduce the uncertainties associated with drug discovery, development and monitoring. As a key part of the global neurological disease research community, the Company has built a global reputation and 20-year track record as an end-to-end Imaging Contract Research Organisation (iCRO) working with leading pharma companies, innovative biotech's, disease consortia and non-profit organisations. IXICO has supported hundreds of neurological clinical trials, analysed hundreds of thousands scans and built an expansive network of expert imaging centres around the world.
The IXICO Platform is tailor-made for neurological disease, reliably processing data from global trials, precisely measuring key imaging biomarkers associated with the identification, progression and treatment of diseases such as Alzheimer's, Huntington's and Parkinson's. Image data is interrogated by the Platform and IXICO's expert scientists translating complex data into clinically meaningful while minimizing data variability and increasing reproducibility.
Our people are empowered to enable us to achieve our company goals and their own personal development through the “4A” values at the heart of our culture: Aspiration, Ability, Agility and Accountability.
To help us deliver our medical image analysis solutions to large clinical trials we are hiring an Associate Image Analyst on a permanent full-time capacity.
NOTE:The Associate Image Analyst is an entry-level role, ideally suited to individuals who enjoy structured, detail-focused and repetitive work, with clear daily and weekly targets.
The position offers a consistent and clearly defined scope of responsibilities and is particularly well suited to individuals looking for stability and the opportunity to build expertise and confidence within an established set of tasks.
Bachelor’s degrees are welcomed and appropriate work experience will be considered. Full training is provided by IXICO.
We are open to discussing fully remote working and flexible working hours for this position.
Purpose of the Role:Image analysis involves using different techniques to derive readings from brain scans. The Associate Image Analyst (AIA) position is responsible for image analysis from clinical data received by IXICO in active clinical trials and research studies. Candidates do not need any previous image analysis experience as all new Analysts will be trained by IXICO. A typical day for an AIA will involve working methodically through batches of different brain analysis results, confirming accuracy of the science pipeline/output image. This job would suit a motivated, methodical worker, with good spatial awareness and attention to detail.
An example of an analysed brain scan and the regions that an AIA will be reviewing for each therapeutic area can be shown here: Associate Image Analyst | IXICO
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative, but not exhaustive of the role. There may be some variation and/or development of these duties and responsibilities without changing the general nature of the role:
Performing image analysis, such as whole brain delineation and LEAP endpoint QC, after suitable training has been completed.Meeting allocated endpoint QC targets assigned by the Team Leader Image Analysis.Performing functions assigned by the Team Leader Image Analysis and Project Managers in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP) and work instructions (WI).Supporting the Image Analysis team in reaching key deliverables.Being the go-to analysts for allocated studies.
The Associate Image Analyst may also be responsible for but not limited to:Qualitative review of images (e.g., MRI, PET) and identifying issues which may affect subsequent quantitative analysis or radiological review.Query management and resolution in a timely and professional manner.Providing feedback on improvements in the image analysis processes.Assist in activities through all stages of site qualification.Be crossed trained for other areas in clinical operations (e.g., data administration).Maintaining accurate records of incoming data e.g., Data Management Trackers.Assist in preparing and updating study documents (e.g., WIs, training slides, Subject Data Forms).Assist in reporting of Key Priority Indicators (KPIs) e.g., Turn-around-times and analysis throughput.Assist in training other AIAs, as required.Maintain open and positive, collaborative channels of communication with all colleagues in particular close teamwork and collaboration with other Analysts within the Image Analysis team.
Qualifications, Key Skills and Competencies required for the role:
Essential:Bachelor’s degree: Appropriate work experience will be considered.Attention to Detail: Able to spot inconsistencies in brain imaging data and maintain high visual accuracy, whilst following established procedures.Repetition Tolerance: Enjoys structured, repetitive tasks that require consistency and focus.Target-Driven: Motivated by meeting productivity goals and contributing to team throughput.Time Management: Able to plan and pace work effectively, whether working in short sessions or longer blocks.Self-Motivation: Comfortable working independently in a remote setting with minimal supervision.Technical Readiness: Willingness to learn and use specialist software tools (no coding or prior imaging knowledge needed).Communication: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when required (e.g., flagging data issues or progress).Prioritisation: Ability to prioritise competing tasks.
Key Deliverables:Continuous learning and development in core responsibilities.Set and meet personal objectives.Self-assessment and recognition of key capabilities.
Benefits:Competitive remuneration package including benchmarked salaries.Staff Annual Bonus Plans and Annual Salary Review.Generous employer pension contribution of 6%.25 days annual leave, increasing up to 28 days with every year at IXICO.BUPA private medical insurance scheme.Life Assurance of 4x annual salary.Employee Benefits Portal, offering various discounts in retail, food & drink, and entertainment.Engaging and social environment, with fundraising and sporting activities and seasonal events such as Summer and Christmas parties.Wellbeing initiatives such as eye tests, flu jabs, and Mental Health Awareness Training.Employee Assistance Programme offering advice and support on a wide range of topics.Hybrid working model pattern split between working in the City of London and remotely.Reimbursement allowance to purchase equipment to support working from home.Generous employee referral scheme offering £2,000 for referring a successful candidate to the company.Financial assistance for professional qualifications.Opportunity to contribute to an industry where your work has an impact every single day.
How to ApplyIXICO is working hard to create a representative, inclusive and empowered team, because we believe different experiences, perspectives and backgrounds make a better workplace, and ultimately better services.
IXICO doesn’t discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion or belief, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other protected class.
This is a great opportunity for a motivated Associate Image Analyst in a permanent full-time* capacity to thrive in an engaging and fast-paced environment, to make a difference on an everyday basis.
If you think IXICO should meet you, please send us your CV and covering letter by email to careers@ixico.com or apply directly via LinkedIn. We are looking forward to your application.
Please note that our entire business is operating under a Hybrid-Working Model, where UK-based employees are required to attend our London office 2 days a week, *however we are open to discussing fully remote working and flexible working hours for this position.
Please note that IXICO will process the data provided by you only in order to perform the outlined recruitment exercise. For more details on what data we process and on what legal basis this happens please view our Recruitment Privacy Policy or contact careers@ixico.com.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Data Analyst / Developer (SQL), Python, AI
Our client is a leading Investment Management company who committed to helping build a more sustainable future. Their Climate Solutions team develops and implements climate response strategies for clients while supporting the integration of climate considerations across their investment capabilities. Working closely with colleagues across Investments, ESG, Stewardship and Distribution, the team plays a key role in developing innovative climate analytics, identifying energy transition opportunities, and supporting climate-focused investment strategies.
The team are looking for a Data Analyst / Database Developer to help enhance their proprietary climate modelling toolkit and deliver scalable data solutions that enable better decision-making across the investment business. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical expertise with meaningful work that supports the transition to a low-carbon economy.
The role would suite someone who has good SQL skills (including Stored Procedures) together with some other coding experience (Python, R, AI). The role does not require Investment Management or ESG / Climate related experience but this is a great opportunity for someone who is interested in getting into this field / environment.
Key Responsibilities:Supporting the development and enhancement of climate scenarios, climate risk analytics, temperature alignment measures and related metrics within their existing platform.Collaborating with investment, ESG and climate specialists to deliver reporting and analytical solutions.Developing, optimising and maintaining SQL databases, stored procedures, functions and data pipelines.Building automated processes to ingest and manage large datasets from internal and external sources.Creating reporting and visualisation tools that support portfolio analysis and investment decision-making.Analysing climate and portfolio data to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights.Embedding AI-enabled solutions into existing workflows and exploring opportunities for future innovation.
Experience Required:Degree qualified in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Data Science or a related discipline.Strong SQL development skills, including experience creating efficient stored procedures, functions and views.Knowledge of database design principles and performance optimisation techniques.Experience working with Python and a willingness to further develop technical skills across modern technologies.Understanding of concepts such as window functions, CTEs, indexing, transactions, source control and job scheduling.Experience using GitHub or similar version control tools, including code review and collaboration practices.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with complex datasets.Interest in climate change, sustainable investing or climate modelling, alongside the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences.

rows.title: Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Lloyds List Intelligence are the trusted experts delivering transparent and actionable maritime data empowering 60,000 professionals around the globe to make confident decisions that drive the safe, efficient, and lawful movement of trade by sea. Our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and industry expertise transform our unparalleled data into unique insight delivered through data and analytics services, news and commentary, and publications.

We have teams working across the globe in data and analytics, product management, editorial and market analysis, technology, marketing, sales, and customer success.

Role Profile

As a Counterparty Risk Analyst, you will carry out targeted research and deliver impartial, high-quality counterparty risk assessments for customers in the maritime industry. You will play a key role in enhancing our counterparty risk report database with actionable insight, and support customer engagement as a subject matter expert. This role involves in-depth qualitative and quantitative research/analysis, with a high degree of stakeholder interaction, and offers the opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our editorial content into data-driven formats.

You will be expected to build and maintain a strong network of contacts in the industry, and to develop your expertise in counterparty risk in your geographical region, and across maritime markets, improving our customer experience and supporting revenue growth. Strong critical reasoning, a curious and highly analytical mindset, and excellent verbal and written communication skills are integral to effectiveness in this role.

This is a full-time permanent role reporting to the Counterparty Risk Lead Analyst in charge of the (location/ region) desk, and offers balanced working between home and our modern and centrally located office with a wide variety of excellent services and transport links situated nearby.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Analysis

Conduct in-depth online research on registered corporate entities utilising various sources including corporate registries, industry databases, and trade press, to uncover ownership structures and financial standing to evaluate company risk profiles.  Plan and conduct interviews with the management/representatives of subject entities and well-placed reliable and insightful market sources to gather qualitative insights. Utilise proprietary and third-party tools and own critical reasoning to determine and assign in-house counterparty risk ratings and credit recommendation aligned with business exposure contexts. 

Reporting & Customer delivery

Produce clear, structured reports covering subject entity ownership, operations, financials, market and risk assessments that support customer decision-making on near-term business transactions, delivered to agreed deadlines and output objectives.  Maintain high-quality output aligned to our data quality and editorial standards. 

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

Build a network of well-placed, insightful market contacts, fostering a trust-based relationship around shared critical insight, supporting product integrity and brand value. Maintain regular contact with customers to maintain knowledge and a proactive approach to support due diligence needs. Develop as a regional and sectoral subject matter expert, supporting customer calls and networking events. Represent the counterparty operations team in cross-functional collaborations and conferences. 

Team Support & Development

Foster collaboration and share information with peers, such as market commentary and analysis, and other in-house data teams that research company and vessel ownership structures, to optimise the quality of data. Stay abreast of market news and continually develop your understanding of the maritime industry and maintain strong awareness of Lloyd’s List Intelligence product developments. 

Essential

What we are looking for:

Critical thinking and analytical skills, and a passion for company and financial due diligence. Highly articulate, with excellent verbal communication and interviewing skills. Excellent “business English” writing skills, and the ability to create clear, succinct long-form reports. An inquisitive, and analytical mindset, combined with critical reasoning. A highly methodical, thorough and detail-focussed work ethic. Strong stakeholder management and time management skills. A flexible, can-do attitude with the ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines with high-quality output. A customer-first approach with ability to adjust priorities to changing circumstances with no adverse impact on customer expectations and relationships 

Desirable 

Our global Analyst team comprises circa 40 professionals with varied backgrounds; proven experience in either business intelligence, consultancy and due diligence, market research, maritime trade and operations or journalism is desirable. Fluency in (preferred language) or in at least one other language relevant to commercial shipping and to the requirements of the UK-based team, such as (in alphabetical order) Danish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, or Turkish. Understanding and analytical knowledge of one or more of the key maritime industry sectors (dry bulk, tankers, container/liner shipping), and familiarity with corresponding risk factors. Experience of researching complex company ownership structures and financial and legal transactions in the maritime industry would be advantageous. A network of contacts in the maritime industry. An understanding of financial statements and the ability to evaluate the financial health of a company by reviewing its accounts. Ability to resolve complex queries constructively and effectively. Ability to identify and consider the impact of external factors when assessing a subject, and ability to assimilate, interpret and analyse detailed information quickly and accurately. 

Our Promise To You – Benefits

25 Days Holiday rising to 27 after 2 years’ service and a day off for your birthdayWork anywhere policy (up to 4 weeks per year, subject to approval)Life Assurance for 4 x SalaryCompany pension scheme: employee contribution of 5% basic salary, matched by an employer contribution of 5% Up to 4 Days Paid VolunteeringHealthy Lifestyle Subsidy up to £250Enhanced Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity, Shared Parental Leave)Flexible benefits including Private Healthcare Plan and Dental Insurance

If you're excited about working for us and have most, but not all of the skills or experience we're looking for, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need!

With over 300 years of maritime heritage, we continue to shape the future of trade intelligence, transforming vessel, ownership, compliance, and emissions data into clarity that drives smarter, safer, and more transparent trade.

rows.title: Data & Project Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us
Lanas is igniting healthcare innovation. For nearly three decades, we have connected GPs, pharmacists, specialists, surgeons, and other healthcare professionals with the best technology possible, from trusted everyday systems to new innovative tools that add real value for our customers.
Our technology is used by millions of clinical users in over twenty countries. From core clinical workflows to AI-driven innovation, our products help reduce admin, improve access, drive efficiencies, and support safer, more connected care.
We are looking for a Data & Project Analyst to play a key role in the operational delivery and ongoing development of Maxwell Stanley's healthcare analytics solution and services. This is a hands-on role combining data analysis, client delivery and project coordination.
You will manage data preparation and processing, analyse outputs, prepare client deliverables and help ensure projects and managed services are delivered accurately and on time. You will also help improve the solution and its underlying processes, while providing project management support to our work with NHS Wales, including customer service desk queries, Privacy Solution activity and wider delivery support.

rows.title: Business Systems Analyst - Metals Trading
rows.descriptionText:
Your Job

Koch Metals Trading Limited (Category 2 LME Member) is seeking a resourceful, builder-minded Business Systems Analyst to support our global Metals trading business from our London office. You’ll be a hands-on partner to traders, risk, operations, and finance — turning ambiguous business problems into working solutions on our Trinity (by Quoreka) trading platform and the data ecosystem around it.

Our Team

We’re looking for someone with a builder’s mentality: you prototype quickly, think carefully about design, execution, testing, and support, and you’re energized by using new and emerging technology to transform the way we work. You bring real technical capability — enough SQL to explore data and answer your own questions — along with the initiative, curiosity, and communication skills to move fast across a busy trading floor and challenge the status quo where a better way exists.

Experience working in a trading environment matters to us. Metals-specific knowledge is a plus, not a prerequisite — if you’re a quick, continuous learner, we’ll help you build the domain depth.

This role is based in our London, UK office.

What You Will Do

 Partner across front, middle, and back office — traders, risk, operations, finance, and IT — to understand problems and deliver high-value solutions across the metals trade lifecycle. Prototype, build, and iterate — turn ideas into working proofs of concept, and be thoughtful about design, execution, testing, and ongoing support. Explore trade, position, P&L, and risk data with SQL to investigate questions, reconcile across systems, and produce analysis the business can act on. Learn the end-to-end trade lifecycle on Trinity — trade capture, pricing, exposure, mark-to-market, P&L, confirmations, settlements, invoicing, warrant management, and regulatory reporting — and help validate flows as they change. Lead requirements conversations with traders and operations; capture current (“as-is”) and future (“to-be”) processes and translate them into clear specifications, user stories, and process maps. Identify opportunities to automate and streamline — including with AI and modern tooling — and continuously look for better ways to do things. Support UAT planning, execution, defect management, and stakeholder sign-off for Trinity changes and adjacent system work. Juggle competing priorities across trader-driven enhancements, risk and regulatory commitments, and platform health. Build strong relationships across London, Wichita, and other Koch metals locations; communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to business and IT partners.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

 Experience working in a trading, commodities, or financial-markets environment, with a working understanding of how a front-to-back trade lifecycle fits together (or the ability to pick it up quickly). A builder’s mentality — demonstrated ability to prototype solutions and be thoughtful about design, execution, testing, and support. Technical capability, including hands-on SQL — able to query data to answer your own questions. Deep Oracle or query-optimization expertise is not required, but you should be comfortable getting hands-on with data. High initiative and resourcefulness — you find a way, drive things forward, and don’t wait to be told. A genuine, continuous learner who is curious about and comfortable adopting new technology to transform how work gets done. Strong analytical and creative problem-solving instincts. Excellent written and verbal communication — articulate, and able to work effectively with different groups across the organization and influence at all levels. Comfort juggling multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.


What Will Put You Ahead

 Experience supporting a metals or commodities trading business, and familiarity with the physical and/or financial trade lifecycle (trade capture, pricing, exposure, P&L, confirmations, settlements, invoicing, and warrant management). Hands-on experience with a CTRM/ETRM platform across front, middle, and back office; experience with Trinity by Quoreka a plus. Familiarity with metals markets — precious (gold, silver, platinum) and base (copper, aluminum, zinc, nickel, lead, tin). Working knowledge of LME warranting, position limits, and post-trade transparency; awareness of UK EMIR REFIT and MiFID II transaction and commodity-position reporting. Knowledge of risk concepts relevant to trading: MTM, P&L attribution, exposure, margin, and credit. Experience implementing AI or automation-driven solutions to drive efficiencies in trading or back-office workflows. Experience with system integrations to ERP, data warehouses, and market data providers (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv), and exchange / clearing interfaces. Experience with Microsoft toolsets and AWS cloud services. Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business field (e.g., Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science); equivalent industry experience will be considered.


At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Koch Minerals & Trading (KM&T) specializes in the innovative procurement, exchange, and delivery of essential commodity products and services that empower our daily way of life. We pursue the development of investments into successful ventures and new, transformative platforms.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

rows.title: Associate Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Department: Data & AILocation: UK - London

Description

Insurance isn’t the first industry most data scientists think of when they imagine cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) work, but the incredibly rich data and nature of the business make it a great place to put AI to use.

CFC's Data & AI team is building production agentic systems that automate complex underwriting decisions — not demos, not proofs of concept sitting on a shelf, but Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and machine learning (ML) pipelines that drive real business outcomes. This role will sit alongside senior data scientists, machine learning engineers, and software engineers, as an analytical counterpart: running experiments, stress-testing assumptions, and generating the evidence that shapes what gets built and how to improve it over time.

This is an Associate Data Scientist role designed for someone early in their career who wants genuine exposure to production AI systems from day one. You'll work closely with, and have the opportunity to learn from, team members while contributing analysis and experimentation work that feeds into live services — such as statistical analysis and LLM evaluation. This will require the kind of careful, evidence-based thinking that makes the difference between an AI system that works in a notebook and one that holds up under real conditions.

The problems are genuinely hard. The data is complex, the decisions are high-stakes, and the domain has the kind of depth that keeps the work interesting. If you want to grow quickly in applied AI and ML — working on real systems, not toy datasets — this is the right environment.

About the role

Design and run experiments that directly shape production AI agents — testing ideas, validating approaches, and turning research into deployed improvements.Actively explore cutting-edge developments in AI and machine learning — with the space and support to experiment, prototype, and bring new techniques into production where they add value.Evaluate and refine LLM-powered workflows — building robust evaluation frameworks, stress-testing agent behaviour, and driving continuous quality improvements in live systems.Explore complex, real-world datasets to uncover insights that meaningfully improve underwriting decisions and system performance at scale.Prototype and iterate on features for AI/ML pipelines, taking ideas from early exploration through to measurable impact in production services.Investigate how agentic systems behave in production — identifying opportunities for improvement, failure modes, and ways to make systems more robust and reliable.Collaborate closely with ML/AI engineers to bridge research and production — contributing code, debugging issues, and shipping improvements end-to-end.Document and present experiments, findings, and methodologies clearly to both technical and business users, making sure insights are reproducible and decisions are traceable.

About you

You will have experience/be familiar with the following:

AI and LLMsFamiliarity with LLM-powered apps and services, evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and other generative AI work — whether through professional experience, coursework, or personal projects.Curiosity about how LLM-based systems behave in production and how to evaluate them rigorously.Experience with ML models (including deep models) and their lifecycle, including training, evaluation and inference.Exposure to experiment tracking tools (e.g. MLflow).Technical skillsProficiency in Python.Working knowledge of SQL for querying and preparing data.Comfort with Git and version control as part of a collaborative workflow.Basic grounding in CI/CD concepts and an interest in how software is tested and deployed.
Analytical foundationsSolid grounding in statistics and probability — comfortable with hypothesis testing, distributions, and drawing defensible conclusions from data.Hands-on experience with exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and building and evaluating ML models.Working knowledge of the core ML model lifecycle: data preparation, training, validation, and monitoring.Working styleDetail-oriented and methodical — you care about getting the analysis right, not just getting it done.Clear communicator, able to summarise findings and explain analytical decisions to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.Comfortable asking questions and working under the guidance of senior engineers while progressively taking on more ownership.Intellectually curious — the kind of person who pulls on threads and wants to understand why, not just what.Nice to haveExposure to designing, implementing, and managing business-critical applications in a production environment.Working knowledge of how ML/LLM systems get productionized: CI/CD pipelines, release processes, monitoring/observability.Knowledge of the insurance domain (not expected — the domain complexity is part of what makes this interesting).

Core Values

Love what you do:
We show up each day ready to take on the world. Our passion and intensity set us apart and makes the difference to our colleagues, customers, brokers and carriers.

Challenge everything:
We’re never afraid to question the way that things are done and we constantly challenge ourselves and others to makes things better.

Have fun, be good:
Insurance is a serious business, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We make it fun to work at CFC, we welcome all viewpoints, and we treat everyone how we would expect to be treated.
